verdict.rationale: Remote is a workforce and payroll platform that exposes workflows, webhooks, a CLI and MCP tools, so versioning automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Webhook delivery history and replays are an adjacent feature: they re-send events and do not version or revert automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
